scope: two isolated Docker network namespaces on one WSL host; concurrent materialized lifecycle bundles; no capacity or physical hardware claim
failure_policy: preserve every attempt; stop progression on failure; no timeout extension or replacement pooling
basis: All twenty 16/32/64/128 native materialized-bundle controls pass; same workload and binaries; bounded next cardinalities
hold_scope: minimum two-second active hold followed by socket snapshots; diagnostic observer, not timing-qualified
progression_stop: No 1024 idle-hold repeat: original 100/s launch span plus hold exceeds the established 10-second negotiated idle lifetime
